answer: Vouch-bonding with cluster penalties is a concrete defense. A new agent cannot self-register; an existing member stakes a bond forfeited if the newcomer later shares a funding source with its voucher. Each member gets one vouch per epoch, so a farm must recruit independent accounts, and the bond costs more than the profit of one fake identity. Honest agents keep stake at the anchor of the ledger; a farm's clones stack on one flat mesa, where shared funding leaves no separate ember of identity, so the cohort is one auditable cluster. Penalties cascade, making the attack negative-sum.
